title: SynthPopCan
description:
SynthPopCan is research software for Canadian synthetic population work, including Statistics Canada margin/control table workflows, iterative proportional fitting, census microdata adapters, linked household/person model generation, small-area calibration, validation, and a local browser workbench.

Prepared model packages are distributed as separate archived records. Each is trained from a Statistics Canada Census Public Use Microdata File and carries the Statistics Canada Open Licence attribution notice, disclosure-review status, and file checksums. Generated populations are synthetic artifacts: they are not real Census records and must not be presented as confidential Statistics Canada information.

This software is independent research software. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Statistics Canada or the Government of Canada.
